# American Academy of Pediatrics (AAP)

> The American Academy of Pediatrics provides comprehensive pediatric healthcare resources, advocacy policies, and educational products to support child health and family well-being.

AAP serves as the leading organization for pediatric healthcare professionals and advocates, offering clinical tools, policy guidance, and products like PediaLink and shopAAP. The organization focuses on health equity, child safety, and addressing social determinants of health through evidence-based advocacy and education.

## Key Topics

- child health
- health equity
- COVID-19 impact
- advocacy blueprint
- pediatric care
- food insecurity
- Medicaid/CHIP policy
- family security
- community health
- clinical resources
- PediaLink
- shopAAP
- EQIPP
- gun violence prevention
- immigration policy

## Advocacy & Policy

- [Featured Policy](https://www.aap.org/en/policy): AAP policy resources covering pediatric healthcare, education, safety topics
- [Blueprint for Children: Healthy Children](https://www.aap.org/en/advocacy/blueprint-for-children/healthy-children): AAP advocacy policies promoting child health, health equity, and COVID-19 response
- [Blueprint for Children: Secure Families](https://www.aap.org/en/advocacy/blueprint-for-children/secure-families): AAP policies on family security including nutrition, Medicaid, CHIP coverage
- [Blueprint for Children: Strong Communities](https://www.aap.org/en/advocacy/blueprint-for-children/strong-communities): AAP advocacy on community development, racism, gun violence, climate change
- [Blueprint for Children: A Leading Nation for Youth](https://www.aap.org/en/advocacy/blueprint-for-children/a-leading-nation-for-youth): AAP policies addressing immigration and global youth health care challenges

## Products & Resources

- [shopAAP](https://www.aap.org/en/shopaap): shopAAP homepage featuring AAP products including PediaLink, EQIPP, PREP

## News & Reports

- [News Releases from the AAP](https://www.aap.org/en/news-room/news-releases-from-the-aap): AAP news releases and announcements on pediatric healthcare developments
- [The State of Children in 2020](https://www.aap.org/en/advocacy/blueprint-for-children/the-state-of-children-in-2020): AAP report analyzing child health challenges, COVID-19 impact, and social justice
- [Transition Plan: Advancing Child Health in the Biden-Harris Administration](https://www.aap.org/en/advocacy/transition-plan-2020): AAP health policy recommendations to Biden-Harris administration for child health
